ordering_rule: Sequence preserves the inherited contract order for auditability; it is not a priority, score, likelihood, or readiness ranking.

queues.candidate_record_type: Code-bearing official current asset register or closeout table
queues.eligible_source_authority: Amtrak or the named acceptance authority
queues.identity_scope: One official station code and one asset identifier in the same record
queues.period_scope: One explicit reporting or closeout period
queues.acceptance_boundary: Closeout state and acceptance authority must be explicit
disqualifiers: Historical identifier without a current official crosswalk
queues.first_eligible_condition: One official candidate record or source-explicit evidence package supplies every required field under the same identity, period, definition, privacy, and authority boundaries.
